title: Localise a video
summary: Put a finished video into another language: translated subtitles, a new voice or replaced on-screen text, from a supplied, reviewed translation.

notFor.when: subtitles in the language spoken in the recording
a generated presenter or avatar speaking the target language instead of the original speaker

qa: Every translated line keeps the source's meaning, names, numbers and units, and a fluent reviewer approved it
Translated captions are regrouped for the target language's length and still clear faces and the platform interface
A new voice has its own word timings and passed localize-review; no source timings or audio reused

intake.ask: What is the source: your own recording, a template project or campaign episode, or a bespoke film from this repository?
intake.why: Each source has a different route and a different gap (Start table)

intake.ask: Which target languages, and subtitles, a new voice, replaced on-screen text, or several of these?
intake.why: Subtitles are local; a new voice and its word timings are paid; replaced text needs a font with the target script

intake.ask: Who supplies or checks the translation, and who is fluent enough to approve it?
intake.why: Local translation can propose candidates; every line still needs a named fluent reviewer before production rendering

intake.ask: Burned into the picture, or a separate subtitle file per language?
intake.why: YouTube takes a subtitle track per language and plays it on demand; feeds watched muted need burned text
intake.default: a sidecar per language for landscape, burned for vertical

intake.ask: Is paid voice generation and alignment allowed, and within what budget?
intake.why: generate:voiceover and align:captions are paid; without a go-ahead the voice stays pending

profiles.note: One subtitle track per language added in Studio; a dub goes in as a separate audio track (Advanced features); loudness reference about -14 LUFS (measured); band is a house rule
A localised vertical cut carries burned target-language captions inside the vertical safe zone; TikTok's ads spec page takes 9:16 up to 10 minutes (band is a house rule)
Burned target-language captions; Reels upload up to 3 minutes (January 2025); band is a house rule

starter.note: caption.bilingual holds the original and a supplied translation per phrase (template projects; the timeline's bilingual caption style draws it on a recut); clean-sentence for a target-language-only track
